clue.text: Support good person facing senility out of the limelight

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
ST, short for saint, is the crossword's good person
old age, the time of senility, gives AGE

explanation.surface: A carer backs a kindly helper looking after someone with dementia, away from public view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'facing' is a link word placing the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre work done behind the scenes happens away from the spotlight, so the idiom matches.

clue.text: Dogmatist hot on Leviticus etc.

parts.note: being hot on or big on something both mean keen on it
Leviticus is a book of the OT, the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A dogmatic person is keen on the strict laws of Leviticus.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigot clings intolerantly to opinions, much as a dogmatist does.

clue.text: Showing mercy is attractive, with powerful emotion at heart

indicators.note: having something at heart places it in the middle of the other word

parts.note: comely means good-looking, attractive
passion is strong feeling

explanation.surface: Being merciful is appealing, with deep feeling behind it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with ... at heart' puts PASSION and AT in the middle of COMELY.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with compassion means behaving mercifully towards others.

clue.text: Group given a role specially allocated

parts.note: a set is a group
an actor's part is a role

explanation.surface: A troupe given a role has been specially cast.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reserved for a particular purpose is earmarked or allocated.

clue.text: Apology from me? It may be conveyed in a meeting

definitions.text: Apology from me? It may be conveyed in a meeting

parts.words: Apology from me? It may be conveyed in a meeting
parts.note: reads as sorry for something said; in minutes, those who could not attend send apologies that are read out

explanation.definitionFit: A person missing a meeting sends apologies for being away, recorded in the minutes.

clue.text: They make a point of jostling, often bent on being seen in pubs

definitions.text: They make a point of jostling
definitions.meaning: joints forming a point when pushing through a crowd

definitions.text: often bent on being seen in pubs
definitions.meaning: bending the arm to raise a glass is how drinkers are seen in a bar

explanation.definitionFit: The arm joints poke out when jostling and bend when drinking.

clue.text: Bishop outside a church, one in a hurry

indicators.note: outside says the bishop's letters stand round the rest

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A bishop stands outside a church, impatient to be off.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone racing about is by definition rushing, a person in a hurry.

clue.text: One polishing a bit of bridge

definitions.meaning: a person or cloth that rubs to shine something
a match in the card game bridge, best of three games

explanation.definitionFit: A cloth that rubs is one sense; in bridge the term is a set of games.

clue.text: Cheerless Pilate out of tune with the realms above

indicators.note: out of tune says the letters are off, jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A gloomy Pontius Pilate is at odds with heaven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of tune' rearranges CHEERLESS PILATE; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancients imagined the heavens as a vast sphere enclosing the earth.

clue.text: Remedy nun concocted in a riverside location

indicators.note: something concocted is mixed up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nun mixes a cure beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: Runnymede is the meadow by the Thames where Magna Carta was sealed in 1215.
explanation.definitionFit: The Thames-side meadow in Surrey is a place on a riverbank.

clue.text: Cells with barriers confining this person

indicators.note: confining says the barriers enclose the other piece

parts.note: gates are barriers across an opening
the speaker, this person, is ME

explanation.surface: A prisoner complains of cells with barred gates shutting him in.
explanation.walkthrough: The prison picture of 'Cells' misleads: these are biological reproductive cells.
explanation.definitionFit: Gametes are reproductive cells, sperm or egg, in biology.

clue.text: Little child's endless desire to see old city

parts.note: a baby is a little child; the 's is a link

indicators.note: endless says the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: to long for something is to desire it

explanation.surface: A toddler's never-ending wish is to visit an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts the G off LONG, leaving LON.
explanation.definitionFit: Babylon was the ancient Mesopotamian capital, a famous city of antiquity.

clue.text: Vehicle needs parking? I usually walk

parts.note: a tram is a vehicle running on rails
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Someone who normally goes on foot grumbles that a vehicle needs somewhere to park.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp is a vagrant who travels on foot, so walking is his usual way of going.

clue.text: State requirement for someone with tatty garment maybe

definitions.meaning: a US state on the east coast

definitions.text: requirement for someone with tatty garment maybe
definitions.meaning: a person whose woolly top is worn out needs a fresh one

explanation.definitionFit: The US state's name, read as two words, is also a fresh pullover for someone in rags.

clue.text: Caught sight of little boy and wept

parts.note: Des, short for Desmond, is a boy's name made little
to weep is to cry, so wept gives cried

explanation.surface: Someone noticed a small boy sobbing.
explanation.definitionFit: To descry is an old word for to catch sight of or discern something.

clue.text: Absent-minded knight's come in seizing goods

indicators.note: come in says the knight goes inside the other word

parts.note: distrait means distracted, absent-minded
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A distracted knight arrives just as property is confiscated.
explanation.definitionFit: Distraint is the legal seizure of property to force payment of a debt.

clue.text: Breakaway state bringing anger to English

parts.note: ire is a literary word for anger

explanation.surface: A state that broke away is causing rage among the English.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland's Irish name; the Free State broke away from the United Kingdom in 1922.

clue.text: Swinger left behind by the digital age?

definitions.text: Swinger left behind by the digital age?

parts.words: Swinger left behind by the digital age?
parts.note: a swinging weight in old clocks, made obsolete by digital timepieces

explanation.definitionFit: The swinging weight that regulates a mechanical clock has no place in digital timekeeping.

clue.text: Dad's good bloke — the key to success?

parts.note: Pa is Dad, so Dad's gives PAS
a good sport is a decent fellow

explanation.surface: Father's friend, a decent chap, holds the secret of getting on.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that guarantees success is called a passport to it, an idiom for a means of entry.

clue.text: Be disloyal to place of work

definitions.meaning: to inform on someone to the authorities, betray them
a workshop, as in 'talking ...' or a ... floor

explanation.definitionFit: British slang uses the verb for informing on someone; the noun also means a workshop.

clue.text: EU glad about the French politician who didn't want us

indicators.note: about signals that the letters are moved around

parts.note: le is the French for the

explanation.surface: Europe is pleased about a French leader who opposed Britain joining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' makes DEGAUL from EU GLAD. Charles de Gaulle vetoed Britain's entry to the EEC in 1963 and 1967, so 'us' are the British.
explanation.definitionFit: The French president who twice blocked British entry to the Common Market rejected the British.

clue.text: Black stuff the man gets to settle

parts.note: soot is black powder from fires
the man, a male person, is HE

explanation.surface: A chimney sweep's black dust lands on a man as it settles.
explanation.definitionFit: To soothe is to calm or settle someone who is agitated.

clue.text: Birds crossing a river heading north for sea channel

indicators.note: in a down clue, heading north means reading the letters upwards
crossing says the birds straddle the other letters

parts.note: tits are small songbirds
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Birds fly over a river making north towards the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: TITS round A and R gives TIARTS, which 'heading north' turns.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow stretch of sea joining two larger bodies of water.

clue.text: Errant pet adored being brought back into the family again

definitions.text: brought back into the family again

indicators.note: errant means straying, so these letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A stray pet that its owners loved is taken back home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Errant' makes READOPT from PET ADORED; 'being' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Adopting a child or animal a second time takes it back into the family.

clue.text: Botanical item conveyed by these palmettes

indicators.note: conveyed by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A plant part is carried within some palm-leaf decorations.
explanation.definitionFit: A sepal is one of the leaf-like parts forming the calyx of a flower.

clue.text: Girl ensnares gent finally and carries on

indicators.note: ensnares says the girl surrounds the other letter

parts.note: a lass is a girl

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word gent

explanation.surface: A girl at last catches a man and continues.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that lasts goes on or endures, carries on.

clue.text: Lack of inclination to move from train that's out of order

indicators.note: out of order says the letters are jumbled into a new arrangement

parts.note: i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A broken-down train will not budge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of order' rearranges TRAIN plus IE together into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics inertia is a body's resistance to changing its motion; loosely, reluctance to act.

clue.text: She takes pride in training youngsters

definitions.text: She takes pride in training youngsters

parts.words: She takes pride in training youngsters
parts.note: reads as a proud teacher; a pride is a group of big cats and the female teaches the cubs to hunt

explanation.definitionFit: The female big cat teaches the cubs in her pride, a group of lions.

clue.text: Herb brings report of the enemy

indicators.note: report of says the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: time is the enemy, as in the saying

explanation.surface: A herb brings news of the enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time is the enemy' is the saying behind the enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: A low aromatic plant used in cooking, a common kitchen herb.

clue.text: Secretary with long hair is seductive type

parts.note: a temp is a temporary secretary
a tress is a long lock of hair

explanation.surface: An office secretary with flowing locks is a femme fatale.
explanation.definitionFit: A temptress is a woman who sets out to entice or seduce.
